purpose: Deepen leading-zero state multiplicity across supply-chain modeling, multimodal ML data, combustion datasets, software-security advisories, multi-omics datasets and environmental radiosonde records while preserving five-character targets exactly.

policy.rule: Leading-zero targets remain exact five-character strings and raw occurrences are retained across all useful domains with zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: DOI components, advisory IDs, release-version URL components, funding IDs and event IDs remain metadata/control observations unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.
policy.no_hit: Later exact occurrences append to earlier observations without normalizing away leading zeros or rewriting search history.
